parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables and displays the user information message.

parameters.name: SubTitle
parameters.description: Message sub title to be displayed.

parameters.name: MessageColor
parameters.description: The color of message text in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: BackgroundColor
parameters.description: The color of the message screen background in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: TitleColor
parameters.description: The color of the message title in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: SubTitleColor
parameters.description: The color of the sub title in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: RequestedNumberOfRepetitions
parameters.description: The number of times the device SHOULD repeat the message.

parameters.name: ExecutedNumberOfRepetitions
parameters.description: The number of times the device repeated the message.

object.description: Definition of user information message displays.
